mapper.sql: iot_device_id, device_code, device_name, device_status, province_id, city_id, county_id, category_code, remark, site_code, site_name, public_site_code, model_code, creator, creator_date, modifier, modifier_date, delete_flag, height, location, longitude, latitude, area_code, adm_code, device_model_code, app_mod_flag
mapper.select:
select distinct m.device_code,m.device_status,m.device_name,m.longitude, m.latitude, m.province_id, m.city_id,m.county_id,m.town_code, pro.area_name as provinceName,city.area_name as cityName, county.area_name as countyName,town.area_name as townName,m.device_code as code,m.device_name as name, '1' as prolevel,'2' as citylevel,'3' as countrylevel,'4' as townLevel from vm_order_devices osd left join vm_device_info_t m on m.device_code = osd.device_code left join sys_area pro on pro.area_code = m.province_id left join sys_area city on city.area_code = m.city_id left join sys_area county on county.area_code = m.county_id left join sys_area town on town.area_code = m.town_code
LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t vod on vod.device_code = osd.device_code and osd.tenant_id = vod.tenant_id and vod.device_type = 4 and vod.delete_flag = '0'
where osd.delete_flag= '0' and m.delete_flag= '0' and m.province_id is not null and osd.ord_status in (0, 1, 2)
and osd.tenant_id = #{param.tenantId}
${param.dataScope} order by m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id,m.device_code

select * from ( SELECT DISTINCT m.iot_device_id, od.device_code as deviceCode, ( case when length(IFNULL(ten.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else ten.device_name end ) device_name, m.device_status, m.category_code, m.site_code, m.longitude, m.latitude, m.location, m.w_zone as wZone, m.device_period as devicePeriod, m.par_angle as parAngle, m.model_code, od.tenant_id as tenantId, pro.area_name as provinceName, pro.area_code as province_id, city.area_name as cityName, city.area_code as city_id, county.area_name as countyName, county.area_code as county_id FROM vm_order_sensor_devices od LEFT JOIN vm_order_customer oc on od.order_code = oc.order_code LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t m on m.device_code = od.device_code and m.category_code = 1 LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_iot_device_rel_t ten on ten.device_code = od.device_code and ten.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and ten.delete_flag='0' and ten.industry_code = od.industry_code LEFT JOIN sys_area pro on pro.area_code = m.province_id LEFT JOIN sys_area city on city.area_code = m.city_id LEFT JOIN sys_area county on county.area_code = m.county_id where od.delete_flag = '0' and m.delete_flag = '0' and od.category_code = 1 and od.ord_status in (0,1,2)
and od.device_code in
#{item}
${param.dataScope} )dt

select * from ( select distinct m.device_code, m.device_status, (case when length(IFNULL(dr.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else dr.device_name end ) as device_name, m.longitude, m.latitude, m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id, m.town_code, m.model_code, m.location, pro.area_name as provinceName, city.area_name as cityName, county.area_name as countyName, town.area_name as townName, '1' as prolevel, '2' as citylevel, '3' as countrylevel, '4' as townLevel, '5' as radarLevel, m.device_code as code, m.device_name as name, m.w_zone, m.device_period, m.par_angle, case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor from vm_order_sensor_devices osd left join vm_iot_device_t m on m.device_code = osd.device_code and m.category_code = #{param.categoryCode} left join sys_area pro on pro.area_code = m.province_id left join sys_area city on city.area_code = m.city_id left join sys_area county on county.area_code = m.county_id left join sys_area town on town.area_code = m.town_code left join vm_tenant_iot_device_rel_t dr on dr.device_code = m.device_code and dr.tenant_id = osd.tenant_id and dr.delete_flag = '0' and dr.industry_code = osd.industry_code left join vm_user_device_collection_t dct on dct.coll_obj_code = m.device_code AND dct.user_id = #{param.userId}
AND dct.coll_obj_type = '7'
AND dct.coll_obj_type = '8'
where osd.delete_flag= '0' and m.delete_flag= '0' and osd.category_code = #{param.categoryCode} and osd.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) ${param.dataScope} order by m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id,m.device_code )dt

select t.device_code, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then t.device_name else rel.device_name end ) name, t.location, ST_Distance_Sphere( ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',#{param.longitude},' ',#{param.latitude},')')), ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',t.longitude,' ',t.latitude,')')) ) as distance, t.longitude, t.latitude, t.w_zone, t.height, t.device_type, t.model_code, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'iot_device_model_type' AND DICT_VALUE = t.device_type limit 1) deviceTypeName, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'iot_device_mfgr_code' AND DICT_VALUE = t.model_code limit 1) modelName,
case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor,
t.device_status from vm_order_sensor_devices o inner join vm_iot_device_t t on t.device_code = o.device_code and t.category_code = 2 LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_iot_device_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = o.device_code and rel.category_code = 2 and rel.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.industry_code = o.industry_code
left join vm_user_device_collection_t dct on dct.coll_obj_code = t.device_code AND dct.coll_obj_type = '7' AND dct.user_id = #{param.userId}
and rel.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = o.industry_code and rel.category_code = 2 where o.delete_flag = '0' and t.delete_flag = '0'
and t.device_status != 2
and o.category_code = 2 and o.ord_status in (0,1,2)
and ST_Distance_Sphere( ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',#{param.longitude},' ',#{param.latitude},')')), ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',t.longitude,' ',t.latitude,')')) ) <= #{param.radius}
AND (t.site_code like CONCAT('%', #{param.searchName}, '%') OR t.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{param.searchName}, '%'))
${param.dataScope} group by t.device_code order by t.iot_device_id
limit #{param.limitSize}

select t.device_code, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then t.device_name else rel.device_name end ) name, t.location, ST_Distance_Sphere( ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',#{param.longitude},' ',#{param.latitude},')')), ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',t.longitude,' ',t.latitude,')')) ) as distance, t.longitude, t.latitude, t.w_zone, t.height, t.model_code, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'radar_device_mfgr_code' AND DICT_VALUE = t.model_code limit 1) modelName,
case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor,
t.device_status from vm_order_sensor_devices o inner join vm_iot_device_t t on t.device_code = o.device_code and t.category_code = 1 LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_iot_device_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = o.device_code and rel.category_code = 1 and rel.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.industry_code = o.industry_code
left join vm_user_device_collection_t dct on dct.coll_obj_code = t.device_code AND dct.coll_obj_type = '8' AND dct.user_id = #{param.userId}
and rel.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = o.industry_code and rel.category_code = 1 where o.delete_flag = '0' and t.delete_flag = '0'
and t.device_status != 2
and o.category_code = 1 and o.ord_status in (0,1,2)
and ST_Distance_Sphere( ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',#{param.longitude},' ',#{param.latitude},')')), ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(',t.longitude,' ',t.latitude,')')) ) <= #{param.radius}
AND (t.site_code like CONCAT('%', #{param.searchName}, '%') OR t.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{param.searchName}, '%'))
${param.dataScope} group by t.device_code order by t.iot_device_id
limit #{param.limitSize}

select s.device_code, c.monitor_code, c.monitor_name, c.monitor_units from vm_sensor_monitor_status s inner join vm_sensor_monitor_config c on c.monitor_code = s.monitor_code where s.device_code in
#{item}

select m.iot_device_id, m.device_code, m.model_code, m.device_model_code, (case when length(IFNULL(dr.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else dr.device_name end ) as device_name, m.category_code, m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id, m.town_code, m.site_code, m.device_status, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.location, m.height, m.w_zone, m.device_period, m.par_angle, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '1' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '3' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '4' END ) orderStatus, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'radar_device_mfgr_code' AND DICT_VALUE = m.model_code limit 1) modelName, case when IFNULL(art.id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end tagCollect, case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor from vm_order_sensor_devices od left join vm_iot_device_t m on od.device_code = m.device_code and m.category_code = 1 and m.delete_flag = 0 left join vm_tenant_iot_device_rel_t dr on dr.device_code = m.device_code and dr.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and dr.delete_flag = '0' and dr.industry_code = od.industry_code left join vm_user_device_collection_t dct on dct.coll_obj_code = m.device_code AND dct.coll_obj_type = '8' AND dct.user_id = #{param.userId} LEFT JOIN vm_ar_tags_tree_user_rel art on art.coll_obj_code = m.device_code and art.coll_obj_type = '8' and art.user_id = #{param.userId} where od.delete_flag = 0 and od.category_code = 1 and m.delete_flag= '0' and od.device_code = #{param.deviceCode} ${param.dataScope} limit 1

select m.iot_device_id, m.device_code, m.model_code, m.device_model_code, m.category_code, (case when length(IFNULL(dr.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else dr.device_name end ) as device_name, m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id, m.town_code, m.site_code, m.device_status, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.location, m.height, m.w_zone, m.device_period, m.par_angle, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '1' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '3' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '4' END ) orderStatus, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'iot_device_model_type' AND DICT_VALUE = m.device_type limit 1) deviceTypeName, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'iot_device_mfgr_code' AND DICT_VALUE = m.model_code limit 1) modelName, case when IFNULL(art.id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end tagCollect, case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor from vm_order_sensor_devices od left join vm_iot_device_t m on od.device_code = m.device_code and m.category_code = 2 and m.delete_flag = 0 left join vm_tenant_iot_device_rel_t dr on dr.device_code = m.device_code and dr.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and dr.delete_flag = '0' and dr.industry_code = od.industry_code left join vm_user_device_collection_t dct on dct.coll_obj_code = m.device_code AND dct.coll_obj_type = '7' AND dct.user_id = #{param.userId} LEFT JOIN vm_ar_tags_tree_user_rel art on art.coll_obj_code = m.device_code and art.coll_obj_type = '7' and art.user_id = #{param.userId} where od.delete_flag = 0 and od.category_code = 2 and m.delete_flag= '0' and od.device_code = #{param.deviceCode} ${param.dataScope} limit 1

select * from ( select DISTINCT m.device_code, case when length(IFNULL(ten.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else ten.device_name end device_name, m.longitude, m.latitude, m.location, m.site_code, m.device_status from vm_order_sensor_devices od LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t m on m.device_code = od.device_code and m.category_code = #{param.categoryCode} LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_iot_device_rel_t ten on ten.device_code = od.device_code and ten.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and ten.delete_flag='0' and ten.industry_code = od.industry_code where od.delete_flag = '0' and od.category_code = #{param.categoryCode} and od.ord_status in (0,1,2) and m.delete_flag = '0'
and m.longitude like CONCAT('%', #{param.longitude}, '%')
and m.latitude like CONCAT('%', #{param.latitude}, '%')
${param.dataScope} order by m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id,m.device_code ) dt
and ((dt.device_code = #{param.keyWord}) or (dt.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{param.keyWord}, '%')))
select * from vm_iot_device_t order by device_code
select id as iotDeviceId, device_code, longitude, latitude from vm_uav_device_info_t order by device_code
select id as iotDeviceId, device_code, longitude, latitude from vm_horn_device_info_t order by device_code
select id as iotDeviceId, device_code, longitude, latitude from vm_recorder_device_info_t order by device_code

update.foreach:
update vm_iot_device_t set
province_id = #{item.provinceId},
city_id = #{item.cityId},
county_id = #{item.countyId},
town_code = #{item.townCode},
town_name = #{item.townName},
location = #{item.location},
update_time = now() where iot_device_id = #{item.iotDeviceId}

update vm_uav_device_info_t set
province_code = #{item.provinceId},
city_code = #{item.cityId},
county_code = #{item.countyId},
town_code = #{item.townCode},
location = #{item.location},
update_time = now() where id = #{item.iotDeviceId}

update vm_recorder_device_info_t set
province_code = #{item.provinceId},
city_code = #{item.cityId},
county_code = #{item.countyId},
town_code = #{item.townCode},
location = #{item.location},
update_time = now() where id = #{item.iotDeviceId}

update vm_horn_device_info_t set
province_code = #{item.provinceId},
city_code = #{item.cityId},
county_code = #{item.countyId},
town_code = #{item.townCode},
location = #{item.location},
update_time = now() where id = #{item.iotDeviceId}

mapper.select: SELECT smf.monitor_code, smf.monitor_name, smf.monitor_units FROM vm_sensor_monitor_config smf WHERE smf.delete_flag = 0 order by smf.create_time desc
